summary: The build script still invokes ncc even though this change removes @vercel/ncc and adds esbuild, so the checked-in build command and dependency set are inconsistent.

findings.title: Removed bundler is still called by build
findings.impact: The only supplied build command runs ncc, but this dependency change removes @vercel/ncc. Unless another unshown tool supplies that binary, a clean install will leave the build command unable to resolve its declared bundler.
recommendedChecks: From a clean install, run the existing build script and require the PR to update that script to the intended esbuild command before removing ncc.

omittedConcerns: The @actions/github 8-to-9 migration is omitted because no bounded official evidence was acquired for it.
No esbuild behavior is claimed because the supplied repository evidence contains no esbuild command or configuration.
